Re: Problem migrating our projects to workflow
text:
Hi Arisha,

Thanks for the info. I see where the migration script looks at the
annotation_task_status and calls workflow_complete() if it is "COMPLETED".
Looking at the SDK documentation for annotation_task_status, I don't see a
list of possible values. Can you tell me where that's documented or give me
the list of possible values? Also, I see documentation for
workflow_complete() which will set the label to the completed stage and
workflow_reopen() which will set it to the 1st annotation stage but I don't
see how to set it to the 1st Review stage. Can you provide me with that
information or point me to the documentation?

Thanks,
Gaitan

subject: Re: Encord <> Neura Robotics | PoC KO recording + Monday support session
text:
Hello Jennifer,

Thanks for the access. I am able to access the project, and I am currently exploring the platform. I have some questions

1. How to make sure there are no spaces between the frames during annotation?  Is there a way for automatic annotation?
2. Which VLM Is used to augment my annotations? Is there a way to annotate human poses?
3. I want to track keypoints across all the frames. How to do it?
4. Can you show an example how to initialize a mask on the object, and track across frames? I see there is an option to do this, but I am having some trouble navigating this.
5. I clicked on submit after annotation, how to view those after submitting?

Overall, I think, we need a quick hands-on walkthrough to use the platform better.
I like the frame wise annotation, and the augmentation using VLMs. It looks good on the example I tested, but we want to understand other features possible through the platform.

Thanks,
Bharath.

subject: Re: Problem migrating our projects to workflow
text:
Hi Anurag,

I'm still having problems assigning a label row to a workflow stage.
Looking at the documentation that you pointed me to, I see how to move a
task within a workflow to a different stage but I'm working with a
label_row and I don't see how to set the stage for a label_row. I'm using
the workflow_migration.py script on your web site and I'm in the section
around line 84 that gets the source label row (label_row_s) and target
label row (label_row_t). If the source status is COMPLETED, the target
label row calls workflow_completed(). What I want to do is to call some
function to set the target workflow stage to the review_stage if the source
status is IN_REVIEW. Is there a way to set the workflow stage for a
label_row?

Thanks,
Gaitan

subject: Re: 30 minute meeting with Leo Leclercq
text:
Hi Leo,

Here's some context for the mock discovery call this Friday.

   - *Prospect:* Nuffield Health, specifically the fitness and wellness
   part of the business
   - *Personas: *Data Director (Ben Kelly), and Alex Alavoine-Andrews (Head
   of Trading).
   - *Opp background*:
      - This is a real opportunity with Nuffield Health that I closed
      whilst at DataRobot for over $800k total contract value
      - Cold call was with Ben, first discovery call included Ben and one
      of his analysts (Aidan).
      - In the first discovery call the technical challenge that
      was blocking AI success was understood enough to indicate that DataRobot
      could solve it. Also, it was explained that currently there is
exec support
      to invest in AI solutions that can solve their fitness and
wellness member
      churn problem.
      - Ben and his analyst (Aidan) were pleased with what they were
      hearing DataRobot could do. They requested a demo but I explained to them
      that ahead of this we need to get Ben's business counterpart involved
      to complete the preparation. He agreed to bring in Alex (Head of Trading)
      for a discussion.
      - Our call on Fri 31st is the call that includes Alex Alavoine.

I will provide an agenda for the Friday call tomorrow. The aim of the call
is to understand the business urgency to solving the churn problem, which
is required to support aligning a senior Data Scientist in DataRobot to
prepare and present a churn use case demonstration of the solution.

Attached is the completed Why Anything for Nuffield Health. At this stage
in the opp I wouldn't have all of the information in the attached so you
can expect for me to ask questions that will seek to uncover information
from the attached.

Best,
Dionys
